Assignment Title: EMPLOYEE SALARY CALCULATION

Assignment Question:
Design an abstract class Employee with fields name (String) and baseSalary (double), and an abstract method calculateNetSalary(). Design an interface Allowance with method getAllowanceRate().
 
Derive two classes that extend Employee and implement Allowance:
• ManagerEmployee - allowance rate of 10%.
• StaffEmployee - allowance rate of 5%.
 
Net salary = baseSalary + (baseSalary * allowance rate). Print the net salary.
 
Input Format:
Line 1: Employee Type (Manager or Staff)
Line 2: Employee Name (String)
Line 3: Numeric Base Salary (double)
 
Output Format:
Line 1: Net salary as a double, or Invalid Input for a non-positive/non-numeric salary or an unrecognized employee type.
